key_findings: The head of the INCD said Iran is seeking to develop AI-powered cyberattack capabilities.

The listing summary gives no technical detail, indicators or named incidents.

summary: Speaking at Cyber Week at Tel Aviv University, the head of the Israel National Cyber Directorate, Yossi Karadi, said Iran is pursuing an offensive cyber capability that uses artificial intelligence, alongside its nuclear programme, and called it a capability that could harm the world. This is an official's public statement; the directorate's news listing gives no technical evidence.
title: Israel National Cyber Directorate: Iran is seeking AI-powered cyberattack capabilities
